name: B10-0119/2026 (Verts/ALE) – Systemic oppression, inhumane conditions and arbitrary detentions by the regime in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the systemic oppression, inhumane conditions and arbitrary detentions by the regime in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly criticises Iran's government for crushing protests with deadly force, mass arrests, torture and poor prison conditions. It asks Iran to release everyone held for speaking out or protesting, stop targeting doctors who treat injured protesters, and allow independent inspectors into prisons. It also asks the European Union to widen sanctions, treat Iran's Revolutionary Guard as a terrorist group, and let Iranians at risk stay in the EU. This is the Parliament's position and request; it does not itself change any law.

- The EU is asked to widen sanctions and treat Iran's Revolutionary Guard as a terrorist group.
- Iranians at risk should get EU visas and not be sent back to Iran.
- Iran should release detainees and open its prisons to independent inspectors.
